english.note: Use this when “insecurely” describes someone acting or speaking without self-confidence.

examples.english: I spoke insecurely the first time I went on stage, as if I were reciting from memory.
examples.traditional: 我第一次上台講嘢，講得冇自信，好似背書咁。
